notes.title: Playtest Update and What’s Next!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,1️⃣ We’d like to inform you that the Playtest version previously available is no longer accessible. Unfortunately, a major bug made the game unplayable, and at this stage, fixing it would not be worth the effort compared to focusing on the core development.

2️⃣ We also want to sincerely thank you for the 310 wishlists our game has already received! Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated to work even harder.

3️⃣ Looking ahead: before the end of this year we’ll be announcing the release date of our Demo 🎉.

 We hope to count on your support during this stage, as your feedback will be crucial to improve the game and shape it according to what players truly want.Thank you all for your patience, trust, and continued support! 💙
